headline: Saginaw Valley State edge Northern Michigan at the top
dek: Saginaw Valley State beat Purdue Northwest to stay above Northern Michigan, who beat Roosevelt on the same day. Northern Michigan have scored 32 goals across all their matches, more than any other programme in the conference, and the two sides meet again at Northern Michigan before the season closes.
displaced_by: Saginaw Valley State now lead the table, Purdue Northwest have fallen back and Roosevelt are no longer unbeaten

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The scoring is top-heavy: Northern Michigan alone have scored more than Purdue Northwest and St. Cloud State together.

wire.line: Saginaw Valley State have lost once all season, and still have a trip to Northern Michigan to come.

findings.label: observed

last_match.line: Saginaw Valley State have not lost since Northern Michigan won at their ground in September.

next_match.line: Saginaw Valley State have not lost since September; Davenport sit level on points with St. Cloud State at the foot of the table.
